dedupe_keys.name: roads and cities of 18th century france

description: Roads and cities of 18th century France is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Julien Perret et al. The evolution of infrastructure networks such as roads and streets are of utmost importance to understand the evolution of urban systems. However, datasets describing these spatial objects are rare and sparse. The database presented here represents the road network at the french national level described in the historical map of Cassini in the 18th century. Coverage: national (FR); published in 2015. Formats: Shapefile, TXT, ZIP, CSV. The data are held in Harvard Dataverse and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 380444. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
